tool.title: LaTeX compilation (latexmk)
tool.description: Compile LaTeX source documents into PDF using latexmk with safe shell-escape isolation across CI events.

inputs.name: tex
inputs.description: The TeX source file to compile (e.g. main.tex).

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: Additional arguments to forward to latexmk.

outputs.name: pdf
outputs.description: The compiled PDF document. Exits 2 if the source file is missing (could-not-determine).
